description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kolavila North, Weligama D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820068 (22/0801)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land titles for multiple parcels of land in Kotavila North. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner names, extent measurements, title classifications, and encumbrances - all characteristic of land-related administrative matters. This falls squarely under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
